brief.objective: Keep the Agent Runner harness advancing through bounded, event-driven management reconciliation for explicitly registered projects.
brief.outcome: Each accepted slice of Agent Runner work is planned, curated, authorised and settled through durable management events rather than a periodic management task.
constraints: One explicitly registered project per management profile
Subscription quota headroom is the only admission signal
nonGoals: Concurrency expansion beyond the single implementation slot
Any separately metered paid execution path
brief.architectureSummary: Node.js modules under scripts/ops validated with node:test, a bounded SQLite control plane under XDG state, and durable management events that wake deterministic role handlers.
risks: Queue evidence can go stale between reconciliations if the accepted base revision moves
A collector outage leaves reconciliation on bounded delayed retry
assumptions: Evidence is collected at the exact accepted source revision
The registered manager profile is current
escalationQuestions: Which proposed work is a product decision rather than an implementation decision?

milestones.title: Event-driven control plane acceptance
milestones.description: Prove the durable management graph against live bounded evidence under supervised shadow observation.

proposedIssues.title: Record bounded shadow equivalence evidence for the management control plane
proposedIssues.scope: Collect and record bounded comparison evidence between the shadow management decisions and the current external management behaviour for each registered project.
acceptanceCriteria: Bounded shadow decisions are recorded for every registered project
Comparison evidence is reproducible from persisted control-plane state

scope: Implement the proposed slice with focused deterministic tests.
stopConditions: Stop and report if the accepted base commit changes.
Stop and report if required validation fails or evidence is ambiguous.
